subject: Interim sandbox credit request while procurement committee finalizes PO
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@lumentx.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interim sandbox credit request while procurement committee finalizes PO

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the trial feedback this week. I wanted to flag that your sandbox is scheduled to expire next Friday (Aug 27) but I understand the procurement committee still needs to sign off on the PO (thanks for the update).

To avoid losing the progress your ML team has made on the integration, would Lumen be open to receiving a short interim credit package (7 days / 100k tokens) while procurement completes the committee review?

What I need from you to move this fast: a one-line confirmation from procurement that the PO is in committee review and a preferred end-date for the extension. If you can reply with that, I’ll route to our promotions team for approval and loop in Camila from Customer Success so we can check usage thresholds.

If it helps, I can also share a compact statement for procurement that summarizes the business justification and security controls (SOC 2 + VPC options) — let me know.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

[attachment: SOW_Lumen_v2.pdf (PDF, 245KB)]

From: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@lumentx.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim sandbox credit request while procurement committee finalizes PO

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and for being proactive. Procurement is indeed presenting the PO to the technology committee on Aug 24; they typically take 48–72 hours after the meeting to route signatures. We’d appreciate the bridge so our engineers can finish the integration tests.

Confirming: procurement@lumentx.com (cc’d on this reply) has the PO in committee review and the preferred extension end-date would be Sep 3 to give us a little runway post-approval.

Can Camila confirm what the 100k token package would unlock (models / endpoints / duration)? Also, please send the short procurement-friendly justification you mentioned.

—Sara
VP Product, Lumen Therapeutics
[sent from mobile]

[Procurement cc: procure@lumentx.com]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@lumentx.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interim sandbox credit request while procurement committee finalizes PO

Sara —

Appreciate the update and thanks for looping procurement. Jordan, tagging Marissa from commercial promotions to confirm approval path.

Quick answers for procurement: the 100k token interim credit we propose includes access to our hosted text-generation endpoints (gpt-s-improved and the small open family used in your tests), streaming enabled, and standard telemetry. Tokens will be consumable only against the trial organization tied to Lumen and will expire on Sep 3 as requested.

Attached is a one-paragraph statement you can forward to the committee summarizing security posture and business intent.

If procurement needs a formal signature, Marissa — can you confirm if we need an internal promo approval form or if you can authorize under our delegated promotional credits policy?

Thanks,
Camila
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Camila / Jordan —

Approved. Under promo delegation I can grant a single 100,000 token interim credit to Lumen (account linked to DEAL-8473). Please confirm the Sandbox org ID and desired expiration (Sep 3) and I’ll push the credit and send a DocuSign acceptance link for record-keeping.

Jordan — please ask Sara to confirm the sandbox org ID (or I can look it up from the HubSpot record). Once Sara confirms, I’ll upload the credit and post an audit entry.

Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
